.. py:function:: ensure_float_colors(array: numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray

   Convert an RGB array to ``float32`` in ``[0, 1]`` range.

   :param array: RGB values as ``uint8`` or floating-point tensor.

   :returns: Normalised ``float32`` array with values in ``[0, 1]``.

.. py:class:: RLBenchTemporalH5Dataset(cfg: DatasetConfig)

   Bases: :py:obj:`torch.utils.data.Dataset`


   Dataset that eagerly loads the entire cache into memory.


   .. py:attribute:: cfg


   .. py:attribute:: path


   .. py:attribute:: _task_names


   .. py:attribute:: _data
      :type:  List[Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]
      :value: []



   .. py:attribute:: _stats
      :type:  Dict[str, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]


   .. py:attribute:: _source_files


   .. py:attribute:: _normalizer


   .. py:method:: __len__() -> int

      Return the number of cached samples.

      :returns: Number of samples loaded into memory.



   .. py:method:: __getitem__(index: int) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]

      Return a deep copy of the sample at ``index`` for safe mutation.

      :param index: Dataset index in ``[0, len(self))``.

      :returns: Mapping containing ``point_clouds``, ``agent_pos`` and ``action``.



   .. py:method:: _process_sample(sample_grp: h5py.Group) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]

      Convert a single HDF5 sample group into tensors.

      :param sample_grp: HDF5 group representing a single dataset sample.

      :returns: Dictionary containing processed tensors for the sample.



   .. py:method:: _resolve_source_files() -> List[pathlib.Path]

      Materialise the list of HDF5 files that should be loaded.

      :returns: List of absolute :class:`Path` instances pointing to cache files.



   .. py:method:: _update_stats(sample: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -> None

      Accumulate per-feature statistics used for normalisation.

      :param sample: Sample dictionary produced by :meth:`_process_sample`.



   .. py:method:: _accumulate(key: str, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> None

      Update running min/mean/max statistics for ``tensor``.

      :param key: Field name whose statistics are being tracked.
      :param tensor: Tensor containing the values to accumulate.



   .. py:method:: _build_normalizer() -> reworked_diffusion_policy.normalization.LinearNormalizer

      Create a normalizer that maps features to approximately ``[-1, 1]``.

      :returns: :class:`LinearNormalizer` built from accumulated statistics.



   .. py:property:: normalizer
      :type: reworked_diffusion_policy.normalization.LinearNormalizer


      Return the per-field linear normaliser built from the dataset.

      :returns: Linear normaliser covering ``point_clouds``, ``agent_pos`` and ``action``.


   .. py:property:: source_files
      :type: Tuple[pathlib.Path, Ellipsis]


      Return the fully-resolved sequence of source cache files.

      :returns: Tuple of absolute :class:`Path` objects.


   .. py:property:: task_names
      :type: Tuple[str, Ellipsis]


      Return the task names requested for this dataset.

      :returns: Tuple of task name strings.


   .. py:method:: _format_action(action_seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor

      Clamp or pad an action sequence to the configured horizon.

      :param action_seq: Raw action sequence tensor ``(T, D)`` from the dataset.

      :returns: Tensor containing exactly ``action_horizon`` steps.



.. py:function:: sample_points(points: torch.Tensor, colors: Optional[torch.Tensor], target_points: int) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Optional[torch.Tensor]]

   Sample or repeat points (and colours) to reach ``target_points`` size.

   :param points: Point coordinates with shape ``(N, D)``.
   :param colors: Optional colour values aligned with ``points``.
   :param target_points: Number of rows desired in the output tensors.

   :returns: Tuple of ``(points, colors)`` truncated or resampled to ``target_points``.


.. py:function:: collate_temporal_batch(batch: Sequence[Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]

   Stack a sequence of samples into a single mini-batch.

   :param batch: Iterable of dataset samples.

   :returns: Dictionary with stacked ``point_clouds``, ``agent_pos`` and ``action`` tensors.
